definition: Pangram is an artificial intelligence detection software developed to identify text produced by large language models (LLMs), developed by Brooklyn-based Pangram Labs.
details: It has been used in a number of high-profile accusations of AI use in published writing, and criticized for contributing to "witch hunts" for AI writing.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Pangram (AI detector) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
